displayName: Strength Save: cost anomaly - Storage egress per hour (OTA live updates)

documentation.content: Default Firebase Storage bucket sent more than 1 GiB in the last hour. Baseline 2026-08-31..09-30 (before the first OTA publication): median 1.0 MB/h, p99 2.8 MB/h, max 3.4 MB/h. The threshold is sized for an OTA release (docs/LIVE-UPDATES.md: bundle of a few MB per device), so 1 GiB/h means roughly 200+ bundle downloads in one hour or a download loop (e.g. a client retrying a failed update). About 0.12 USD per GiB. Check client_errors codes live-update-*, then docs/COST-GUARDS.md; rollback of the OTA channel stops the traffic.
